svg.title: The future blanks return with the open questions still present
svg.desc: Return to the future blanks with report, map and critique still open. Unresolved questions accompany the ending instead of disappearing for narrative neatness. Keep the recurring home window and shelves distinct from institutional review settings; this domestic interior remains reconstructed.
